objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with a swollen neck and systemic symptoms suggestive of a thyroid disorder.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’m a 40-year-old woman, and for about three weeks I’ve noticed a swollen spot on the front of my neck that started small, round, and painless, but it’s been getting larger. I also feel like I have hyperthyroid-type symptoms—sweaty palms and soles, insomnia, irritability, nervousness, and fatigue.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any scratched, rubbed-raw skin or small open spots on my body or neck.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you suddenly wake up gasping for air during sleep? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had episodes where I stop breathing or wake up gasping for air during sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any injury to cause severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using an area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist, and I don’t have any skin changes like that elsewhere either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored skin on the chest), especially after an injury or from coughing/strain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall—no dark or discolored areas from injury, coughing, or straining.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine than normal?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed urinating much more than usual or producing a larger amount of urine.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t used tobacco, alcohol, cannabis, opioids, or stimulants, and I’m not currently using any drugs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine—no leaking or accidents, and I can make it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere on your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere else on my body—just the swelling on the front of my neck that’s been enlarging over the past three weeks.”
